text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I had such a great break! I put my original strategy for getting great sleep into action. It's called…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The "Warm Up in the Bath and Go Straight to Sleep Method"! It was super effective!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. I made sure to write down my strategy in elaborate detail, so I can teach it to you later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Putting her "strategy" aside, Matikanetannhauser seems to have gotten plenty of rest!
